posts.description: Declutr sorts your Desktop, Downloads or any folder into folders by file type in one click: Images, Documents, Videos, Archives, Code, 3D Models and more. posts.description: Your vendors already send bills on WhatsApp. Now forward them to Zoffer. It reads each bill, printed or handwritten, pulls out the vendor, date, line items, tax and amount, and creates the entry in your Zoho Books. Nothing posts until you check it and tap approve. No new app to learn. You keep using Zoho Books the way you do today, minus the typing. Made for small businesses in India that get dozens of bills a month and don't want to hire someone just to enter them. ₹999/month.

posts.name: gigs.monster
posts.tagline: Concerts near you + the setlist they're playing this tour
posts.description: gigs.monster is a map of upcoming concerts worldwide. Pick a city, see who's playing this weekend, and hear the actual setlist from their current tour as a Spotify playlist before you buy a ticket. Travelling for a show? Every event page has a map of nearby places to stay. Built solo by a frontend dev who was tired of missing shows.

posts.name: Zeku
posts.tagline: A calm place to write for your Astro site
posts.description: Zeku is a native app that opens your Astro project directly, with live-preview markdown, frontmatter that knows your schema, and a publish button.

posts.name: WebSnarks Website Health Checker
posts.tagline: Check your website's overall health in one free scan
posts.description: A quick, free health check for your website. Spot technical issues, SEO gaps, and things quietly costing you visitors and leads, then get a clear report on what to fix first. No jargon.

makers.name: WebSnarks
makers.headline: Web design, SEO & free website tools

posts.name: kdpbook.io
posts.tagline: Lovable for books: chat your idea, get a KDP-ready book
posts.description: kdpbook.io is an AI book studio for Amazon KDP. Think Lovable, but for books: describe the book you want in a chat, or import your manuscript, and it writes, illustrates and typesets it. Then it exports the files KDP asks for: interior PDF, full-wrap cover PDF sized from the page count, Kindle EPUB and a listing sheet. 36 book types, from picture and coloring books to novels. KDP trim, bleed, margin and spine rules are applied by code. 2,000 free credits at signup, no card.

posts.name: FleetSwarm AI
posts.tagline: Breakdown to dispatch, over WhatsApp, in minutes not calls
posts.description: Fleet Swarm is an AI-agent system that automates vehicle breakdown handling over WhatsApp — no app install needed. When a vehicle breaks down, the driver just messages on WhatsApp: AI diagnoses the issue (including from photos), finds the nearest repair hub via Google Maps, gets vendor quotes, and routes manager approval — all in chat. It also detects urgency, auto-matches the driver's language, and learns from manager-approved fixes over time. Built for Beekay Infra & Logistics.

posts.name: 2FA Authenticator
posts.tagline: Modern authentication in Chrome. 200,000+ users trust us.
posts.description: Most authenticators want an account, a cloud, or permission to read every page you visit - and they live on your phone. This one lives in your browser and has no server at all. Codes are one click away, no reaching for your phone. Password-protect the vault, unlock it with Touch ID, and share a code by link that carries pre-computed codes - never your secret key.

posts.name: LinkModus
posts.tagline: AI sales agent that proves which ads actually make money
posts.description: You know your cost per click. Do you know your cost per paying customer? LinkModus is an AI sales agent that answers, qualifies and follows up on every enquiry — on WhatsApp, your website and your app — then traces every sale back to the exact ad that produced it. ✅ Real CAC & ROAS per ad ✅ Leads that never go cold ✅ Alex, an AI founder agent that tells you what to fix first Live in minutes. 7-day free trial.

posts.name: DayClerk Marketing Campaign Generator
posts.tagline: AI Campaign Pages Built Around Audience Behavior
posts.description: DayClerk is an AI marketing suite that simulates how specific audience segments think and behave before generating full campaigns. From a single brief, DayClerk models buyer friction points and generates tailored landing pages published to a live URL, email copy, ad copy, and social posts built for your specific segments. When all of your marketing assets are synchronized, the promise of your offer is kept. No agency or research team needed, launch full campaigns in under 15 minutes.

posts.name: Anuma: Chat & Meet People IRL
posts.tagline: From private AI conversations to real-world connections.
posts.description: We are launching Nearby, the new feature that brings Anuma's memory into the real world. Anuma is the private, multi-model AI chat app that remembers. Nearby helps you discover people around you who share your interests and make plans IRL. The more you use Anuma, the better it knows you, and the better your matches get. - See who's around on a live map - Ask who you'd click with and get match scores - Join events and make plans IRL Opt-in. Your chats stay private. Now live in NYC.

makers.name: Alex Kim
makers.headline: Text AI with your phone number.

posts.name: Presslyte
posts.tagline: Edit WordPress content, not your website layout
posts.description: Keep your WordPress website current without learning how it was built. Presslyte lets you change business hours, correct a typo, refresh a service description, or replace an old photo by editing supported text and images directly on the page. Review and save changes while layout controls stay protected. Developers can give clients focused editing access, and enterprise teams can work within existing WordPress permissions.

posts.name: The Night Atlas
posts.tagline: Map your subconscious
posts.description: The Night Atlas is an AI-powered dream journal built on Jungian psychology. Log your dreams and get a deep symbolic analysis — archetypes and personal symbols — then watch how they evolve over time. It's designed to support what Jung called individuation: the lifelong process of becoming who you are.

posts.name: Riplox Desktop
posts.tagline: Share a link from your phone. Your PC downloads it.
posts.description: Riplox is a free, open-source video downloader for Windows. Paste a link and keep the file at up to 8K, or MP3. Or pair your phone once and share links from any app: your PC downloads them, even if it was off when you sent them. Only the link travels, sealed, and on the same Wi-Fi it never leaves your network. Whole playlists and channels, Following for new uploads, convert, trim, schedule, and a public Board of links. No account, no caps, no ads, nothing bundled. GPL-3.0.

makers.name: Muhammad Nazim
makers.headline: Family of free games and tools.

posts.name: Fud AI
posts.tagline: Free open-source AI calorie & workout tracker
posts.description: Fud AI is a free, open-source calorie and workout tracker for iOS and Android. Snap up to 10 meal photos, scan a barcode, speak, or type — AI estimates nutrition. Bring your own key (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, and more); optional hosted AI on iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Also: workout diary with an 877-exercise library, intermittent fasting, water, widgets, Apple Watch, HealthKit / Health Connect, and an AI Coach — all local-first and MIT licensed.

posts.name: Tidyshot
posts.tagline: Blur, annotate and find any screenshot by its text
posts.description: Tidyshot lives in your Mac menu bar and handles every screenshot you take. Blur or pixelate private info and add arrows or callouts in one click. It reads the text on-device, so you can find any screenshot by what's written on it. Receipts, code and links land in Smart Collections, and everything is sorted by app. Redact covers emails, phones, cards and QR codes before you share. Works with ⌘⇧4, CleanShot or Shottr. No account, no cloud, no subscription.

posts.name: CraftCX
posts.tagline: Observability & Intelligence tooling for AI Support Agents
posts.description: Understand every conversation your AI support agent handled, identify recurring customer issues, and review the evidence behind every finding with CraftCX.

posts.name: Siena - Networking Done For You
posts.tagline: Ask for connections, Siena will get straight to finding them
posts.description: Your Waivly Concierge 🌎 Looking for someone, something, or somewhere to start? Tell me what you need and I’ll see what I can find.

posts.name: WordCanvas3D
posts.tagline: See how AI reads text: tokens, embeddings and vector math
posts.description: WordCanvas3D is a free, open-source playground for how AI understands text. Split any sentence into tokens and compare how GPT and LLaMA tokenizers see it. Fly through thousands of words in 3D and watch similar meanings cluster together. Do math with meaning, like king − man + woman ≈ queen. New in v2: a Learn section with beginner-friendly articles and interactive figures, a full redesign, phone support, and English, Chinese, Japanese and Spanish.

posts.name: Mind Atlas
posts.tagline: Map how your mind works: imagery, memory, inner voice
posts.description: Some people see vivid pictures when they close their eyes, others see nothing. Mind Atlas turns five short self-tests (visual imagery, the other senses, autobiographical memory, inner voice and a perception experiment) into a living map of your mind. After three you meet your archetype, after five your atlas is complete, with a Full Mind Report that is free during our pilot. No sign-up, and your answers never leave your browser. In 5 languages.

posts.name: Evolution of the Web
posts.tagline: Experience 35 years of the web in one website
posts.description: Remember when websites had visitor counters, guestbooks, blinking GIFs and “Best viewed in Internet Explorer”? Evolution of the Web lets you travel through the internet one era at a time, from the early ’90s all the way to a speculative 2040. Every era changes the design, technology, interactions and culture of the site itself. How many eras of the web do you remember?

posts.name: Port42 · What will you imagine?
posts.tagline: A Mac desktop where your AI companions build together
posts.description: Port42 is a Mac desktop for your AI companions. Claude Code and Codex build live apps together on one desktop, in the same chat as you. Port42 runs no model and holds no key.

makers.name: Gordon Mattey
makers.headline: Building Port42 · What will you imagine?

posts.name: Goldseat
posts.tagline: Give your product the spotlight it deserves.
posts.description: GoldSeat is a simple directory for discovering and promoting great products. List your product, SaaS, or app for free. If you want more visibility, you can pay to move into a higher spot. No subscriptions. No complicated packages. Just a simple way to put your product in the spotlight. Built for makers who want more people to discover what they’ve built.

posts.name: ChatGPT Update Notifier
posts.tagline: Get notified on updates for the ChatGPT Linux app.
posts.description: Well, I kept missing ChatGPT desktop app updates and was suprised that the Linux app did not have an update flow built-in. I am sure OpenAI will eventually address this. Until then, here is a small, unofficial notifier for the ChatGPT desktop app on Linux. The Windows version of the app already has this update-checker feature. It checks the signed OpenAI package repository and reminds you about newer app versions. It never installs an update without your confirmation.

posts.name: heade.rs
posts.tagline: See where any website lives and how your traffic gets there
posts.description: Every domain lookup site looks like it's from 2004. So I built the one I wanted: https://heade.rs Type in any website and see where it's hosted, the route your traffic takes to get there, what it's built with, who registered it, and which AI bots it lets in. Fast, beautiful, free, no sign-up, and works from a terminal or MCP.

posts.name: Briskly
posts.tagline: Couch to 5k but for cleaning
posts.description: The cleaning app for people who hate cleaning. Point your camera at the mess and Briskly's AI scans the room, builds a timed task list, and races you through it. About 20 minutes, then swipe the before/after slider for proof you actually did it. On-device Vision AI (no cloud, no data collected), lock screen Live Activity, Apple Watch support, and Spotify/Apple Music built in. Unlike schedule-based cleaning apps, Briskly assumes you'll never follow a schedule. Done before you know it.

posts.name: Open World Clock
posts.tagline: Time zones for Windows, free and open source
posts.description: A world clock for Windows made for working with people in other time zones. Add the cities you work with and see them side by side. Type a time or scroll over any clock and every city converts at once. The meeting planner shows the hours when everyone is inside working hours, and there's a live day and night map. Free and open source (MIT), no ads, no account, and the app sends nothing anywhere. On the Microsoft Store, or try the real app in your browser first.

posts.tagline: The hosted MCP gateway for teams without an IT department
posts.description: Point Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex — any MCP client — at one endpoint. Configure MCP servers for your whole team, store credentials once (encrypted), give every member their own key, and see who called what. No Kubernetes, no sales call. From $29/mo.

First file free during the pilot.

posts.description: We're live on the App Store. Snag Mode is a universal social wishlist for the cool, weird, expensive, unnecessary, and extremely necessary things you find across the internet. Save products from anywhere. Build a profile around your taste. Discover what other people are snagging. Stalk people with good taste. posts.description: Load a PDF or image template and an Excel/CSV file, drag text boxes and QR codes onto the page, and get one PDF per row (ZIP), a single merged PDF, or print sheets for badges and labels. Fills existing PDF forms too. 100% client-side: files never leave your browser.

posts.name: Time Capsule
posts.tagline: Send a digital time capsule to your people in the future
posts.description: Create a digital time capsule with photos, videos, documents and messages. Choose when it opens and who receives it. One payment, no subscription.

makers.name: Sébastien Morel
makers.headline: Failing is giving up before succeeding!

posts.name: Balkan Premium
posts.tagline: www.prevozpokojnikabalkan.ch
posts.description: Balkan Premium – profesionalan međunarodni prevoz pokojnika iz Njemačke, Austrije, Švicarske, Italije, Holandije, Švedske, Slovenije, Velike Britanije i Španije za Balkan. Kompletna dokumentacija i dostupnost 24/7.

posts.name: CineGen
posts.tagline: Turn text into cinematic video in minutes
posts.description: CineGen turns your words into cinematic AI videos — no filming, no editing skills needed. Describe a scene, pick a format, and get a 1080p/2K clip in about 90 seconds, ready for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or product ads. Start free with 50 credits, no credit card required. Pro from $9.90/mo.

posts.name: SeenSure
posts.tagline: Know when AI crawlers stop being able to read your site
posts.description: SeenSure checks whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other AI crawlers can actually reach a site, and tells you when that changes. It checks daily on the free plan and every six hours on paid ones, and says "cannot confirm" instead of guessing when a CDN gets in the way. Built for people who look after client sites. Free for one site, no card.

makers.name: SeenSure
makers.headline: Know if AI crawlers can read your site

posts.name: Parsekit — Free JSON Tools for Developer
posts.tagline: Free, browser-only JSON tools — no signup, no uploads
posts.description: Free, fast JSON tools that run entirely in your browser: format & validate JSON, convert JSON to CSV, and merge JSON files. No signup, no upload.

posts.name: MockJSON API
posts.tagline: Create instant JSON endpoints for testing.
posts.description: Create and host mock JSON API endpoints instantly. Free mock API tool with JSON storage, converters (JSON to TypeScript, CSV, Go, Java, Python, C#), formatter, diff, schema generator, and more. No signup required.

posts.name: frescosolutions
posts.tagline: The Noble Beauty Shopify Theme is a modern  beauty brands
posts.description: The Noble Beauty Shopify Theme is a modern and visually stunning solution crafted especially for beauty brands, cosmetic stores, skincare businesses, salons, and wellness products. Designed with elegance and performance in mind, this Beauty Shopify Theme helps you create a luxurious online shopping experience that attracts customers and boosts conversions. With its stylish layouts, clean typography, and responsive design, Noble ensures your products look professional on every screen size

posts.name: HEXOLIO
posts.tagline: Free color tools without the clutter
posts.description: HEXOLIO is a free, browser-based color workspace for designers and developers. Convert HEX, RGB, and HSL values, build palettes, create CSS gradients, check WCAG contrast, extract colors from images, and learn through practical guides—all without creating an account. Core tools run locally in your browser, and image analysis stays on your device.

posts.name: TabVault — Tab Workspace Manager
posts.tagline: Save, organize and restore your Chrome tab sessions
posts.description: TabVault is a free Chrome extension that saves your open tab sessions so you never lose your work. Features: auto snapshots, named workspaces, global search across sessions, one-click restore, backup & import/export. 100% local and private — your tabs never leave your browser. Open source (MIT). No accounts, no tracking, no ads.

posts.name: PingZeus
posts.tagline: Uptime monitoring that says what broke, not just that it did
posts.description: PingZeus watches your website and, when it goes down, tells you what broke, what it likely means, and what to check first, in plain English instead of a red/green badge. Built for small businesses and agencies who don't want to decode a status page at 2am. Failures are confirmed across consecutive checks before you're alerted. There's a free plan, and paid plans start at $9/mo. No sales call, no contract.

posts.name: StackSplitter
posts.tagline: Split PDF stacks by barcode, QR code or text marker
posts.description: StackSplitter splits a PDF stack into separate documents by barcode, QR code, or text marker - runs entirely in your browser, no upload. Free for one stack at a time; batch mode (multiple stacks at once, saved split rules) is part of the paid Pro plan.

posts.name: Mixdesk
posts.tagline: AI customer engagement for global teams. No per-seat fees.
posts.description: Mixdesk is an AI customer engagement platform for teams selling and supporting across borders. WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, TikTok, LINE, Telegram, web chat and email land in one inbox. An AI Agent trained on your business knowledge resolves routine conversations, detects the customer's language, qualifies leads and hands off to a teammate with full context, 24/7 in 27+ languages. Usage-based pricing, no per-seat fees, free plan to start.

posts.name: RunAnalyz
posts.tagline: running analyze by EF/80-20 rules from strava
posts.description: Track running shoe lifespan, Strava real-time heart rate & pace analytics, 80/20 polarized 7-Day custom training plans, and Instagram recap card studio.

posts.name: Fab Shop Cone Layout
posts.tagline: Flat pattern layout for cones and transitions
posts.description: Fab Shop Cone Layout generates accurate flat patterns for cones and transitions — concentric or eccentric cone frustums, square/rectangular-to-round, oval-to-round, and pyramid transitions — ready to send straight to your CNC burn table. Exports DXF files. A focused $0.99/year tool for sheet metal fabricators, with a free 3-day trial.

posts.name: Skilize
posts.tagline: AI powered Job Preparation Tool With Free AI Resume Builder
posts.description: Skilize is an AI-powered career launchpad: build an ATS-friendly resume, generate a tailored cover letter, close skill gaps with AI micro-courses, study a personalized interview prep book, and rehearse with realistic AI mock interviews.

posts.name: Sengoku Ukiyo
posts.tagline: Live an entire life in a dynamic Sengoku-era Japan
posts.description: Sengoku Ukiyo is a historical life-simulation RPG set in Japan from 1560 to 1615. Begin at age 18 and live through age 73 among 6,943 named townsfolk and 85 warlords. Choose from 11 lifestyles, build relationships through free-text AI dialogue, navigate a dynamic regional economy, and shape your story across 6,112 quest arcs with 19,803 decision nodes. Available on iOS.

posts.name: Still Health
posts.tagline: The Inactivity Optimizer. Trophies for sitting. Real data.
posts.description: Still Health is the Inactivity Optimizer: a fitness app that tracks stillness instead of steps. Press Start, sit down. It measures the session on real motion data, keeps it alive through phone sleep, and awards trophies for sitting. Premium adds the league: teams, standings, and WEEKLY HONORS for each team's stillest member every Monday. The joke is played straight; every number on screen is real. Free to track. Basic $4.99 once. Premium $4.99/mo or $24.99/yr (7-day trial on yearly).

posts.name: OmniMac
posts.tagline: A Dynamic Island for any Mac, plus ten utilities in one app
posts.description: Free, open-source macOS menu bar app: a Dynamic Island that works on Macs without a notch, per-app volume and equaliser, window layouts, clipboard, OCR. 0.017–0.033 % CPU.

posts.name: Sleep Sanity
posts.tagline: Helping babies and their parents sleep through the night
posts.description: Sleep Sanity is a free baby sleep tracker built for parents who are too tired for forms. Log put down, asleep, night wakes and feeds in one tap each, get a 0 to 100 sleep score every morning, and follow a gentle, age based plan with graduated check-ins. Works offline, no account needed, both parents can sync. No ads, no in app purchases.

posts.name: Unilytic
posts.tagline: Optimize FBA inventory. Recover lost reimbursements.
posts.description: Unilytic is an Amazon FBA operations platform for smarter inventory, shipment planning, returns, and reimbursements. Connect Amazon via SP-API to see inventory across warehouses, get replenishment recommendations, prioritize shipments, manage returns, and identify potential FBA losses. Built to replace spreadsheets and scattered workflows with one simple platform.

posts.name: Canopio
posts.tagline: See what your Etsy listings actually keep after fees
posts.description: Free in-browser Etsy fee calculator: see what one order keeps after the 6.5% transaction fee (which also hits shipping), payment processing, and Offsite Ads 12–15% with the $100 cap. Then drop your shop CSV to find losing listings, ranked worst-first with suggested prices. Free listing score too. Paid is one-time — $9.90 Shop Audit, $2.99/$9.99 rewrite packs — no subscription. Data never leaves your browser.

posts.name: Propeller
posts.tagline: Get your next move with no guessing
posts.description: Most merchants know they should be posting consistently on social and blogs, but don't know what to post, don't have time to write captions, and have no idea whether any of it actually leads to sales. Content creation and strategy end up as the first thing that gets skipped when things get busy. Propeller is built natively on Shopify data (your actual catalog, brand voice, and sales history), so it recommends what to post and why, not just how to write about something you already decided on.

posts.name: ETeext
posts.tagline: Styled text editor — offline, ad-free, accent-safe
posts.description: Every "fancy text" site does one line at a time, buried under ads. ETeext is a real editor: mix bold, cursive, gothic and emojis inside whole paragraphs, see exactly what you'll paste (WYSIWYG), and stop worrying about broken characters — Safety Mode sticks to the widely-supported ranges. The editor, the styling and copy all work offline, with zero ads and zero tracking. Available in 13 languages, including full support for accented alphabets that other generators silently drop.

makers.name: Denis Cadamuro
makers.headline: ETeext — styled text that keeps accents

posts.name: Payout Reconciler
posts.tagline: Explain Stripe payout mismatches without file uploads
posts.description: Compare Stripe payout exports with bank statements directly in your browser. Payout Reconciler classifies exact matches, date shifts, ambiguous deposits, currency mismatches, unexplained differences, and unmatched rows. No Stripe login or bank connection is required, and financial file contents are never uploaded. Free pilot for bookkeepers, founders, and finance teams.

posts.name: Proxmint
posts.tagline: Free live proxy list and open API, refreshed every 30 min
posts.description: A free, live proxy list — HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS4 and SOCKS5 — re-checked every 30 minutes and ranked by reliability. Free proxies die fast; see our paid pools.

posts.name: Voiyada
posts.tagline: AI + human customer support for e-commerce, from $1
posts.description: Voiyada answers your customers instantly, 24/7 — order status, product questions, returns — with AI that hands off to a real human specialist on anything it can't handle. No bots pretending to be human, no customers left waiting overnight. Starts at $100/month, or try it for $1 for your first 7 days.

posts.name: TrueJust
posts.tagline: Job ad promises vs. reality — built for Italy 🇮🇹
posts.description: TrueJust is an Italian community board (the site itself is in Italian 🇮🇹) where job seekers share what really happened when a job posting didn't match what was offered on the phone or in the interview. Anonymous nicknames, real stories, moderated by the community — built to protect Italian job seekers from misleading job ads.

posts.name: Dorfic
posts.tagline: Convert, compress & resize images — 100% in your browser
posts.description: Dorfic is a free suite of image tools that runs entirely in your browser — convert HEIC to JPG, compress images to an exact KB target, resize, and convert between PNG/JPG/WebP. No uploads, no servers, no accounts. Your photos never leave your device. Built for anyone who needs a quick fix for a government form, a job application, or an iPhone photo that won't open on Windows.

posts.name: CarrierTrail
posts.tagline: Research carriers and keep a record of your decisions
posts.description: CarrierTrail helps freight brokers research carriers by USDOT or MC number, review public FMCSA information, monitor changes and keep team notes and decision evidence together. Start with a free public lookup; paid plans add monitoring and team workflows.

makers.name: EMMANUEL Badu
makers.headline: Founder of Ledger Road and CarrierTrail

posts.name: MockForMe
posts.tagline: AI-powered API Simulation for developers, QA, UX
posts.description: From zero to API simulation in seconds. Install the Chrome Extension, open your app, and simulate APIs directly from the DevTool — with no code or SDK. Go beyond basic responses with offline simulation, flows, server-side simulation, and Web, Android & iOS support.

posts.name: Shard Studio
posts.tagline: Shard Studio is a premium marketplace for Minecraft Servers
posts.description: Shard Studio is a premium marketplace for ready-to-use Minecraft server setups, plugins, configs and builds. Launch a DonutSMP, Lifesteal or Skyblock server in minutes with optimized, fully configured resources.

posts.name: FactoGraph
posts.tagline: AI that stops inventing answers
posts.description: AI invents dates, mixes sources, and forgets what you already confirmed. FactoGraph fixes that. You approve the facts. Conflicting ones get caught before they’re saved. Every answer comes with a trail: sentence → fact → source. Works with your favourite AI assistants: Grok, Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and many more.

posts.name: HostDeFi
posts.tagline: Solana & EVM swaps with a token-safety scanner
posts.description: HostDeFi is a Solana DEX with a free token safety scanner. Best-route swaps through Jupiter, EVM trading across 7 chains, native bridging, and live token risk grades. No KYC, 1% flat fee.

posts.name: OmegaFP
posts.tagline: Shaped by advisors, one feature at a time.
posts.description: OmegaFP is an AI-native operating system for financial advisors and RIAs, combining a CRM, AI meeting notetaker, and an autonomous AI assistant in one system. The the platform serves as the central operational hub to eliminate redundant processes, streamline overhead, and ultimately elevate the entire client experience.

posts.name: TakeHome Pay
posts.tagline: Calculate your real take-home pay after taxes
posts.description: Free take-home pay calculator. Enter your salary and see your net pay after federal, state, and local taxes for all 50 US states. Supports 401(k), HSA, FSA and other pre-tax deductions. No sign-up required.

posts.name: PhronexusAI
posts.tagline: Trade ad exposure with complementary SaaS tools, not spend
posts.description: PhronexusAI is a cross-promotion network for B2B SaaS. Instead of paying Google or Facebook to guess at your audience, you exchange ad exposure directly with complementary tools — never competitors. Two modes: Auction (performance-based) and Balance (guaranteed 1-for-1). AI-guided setup in minutes, no developer needed. Free for 90 days.

posts.name: MoodMo
posts.tagline: Turn feelings into a Mind Garden you can tend
posts.description: MoodMO turns feelings into a Mind Garden: weather for emotion, pots for relationships. Standouts vs typical trackers: Relationship Timeline (by person), On This Day (same day, different years), Soft Stack Home widget (garden weather only—never diary text), Vent & Release. Log fast: intensity, people/trigger tags, voice, auto drafts. Offline-first, optional sync, EN & 简体中文. Optional AI only with your Groq key. Self-observation only—not medical advice. Free on the App Store. MIT open source.

posts.name: Buqq
posts.tagline: Commission-free restaurant booking and table management.
posts.description: A standalone B2B restaurant reservation engine built to eliminate third-party commission fees. Run your seating inventory independently with direct guest booking pipelines, digital calendar logic, and automated real-time alerts via the Telegram Bot API.
